title: Rumoured deep underground military bases
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Rumoured deep underground military bases, about unspecified at Edwards, Nellis, Peterson, Cheyenne Mountain/NORAD, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and there are rumors of deep underground military bases from Edwards to Nellis to Peterson and Colorado and and Cheyenne Mountain Complex norat

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels mentions rumours of deep underground military bases hidden beneath several American sites: Edwards and Nellis, two Air Force bases in California and Nevada, Peterson in Colorado, and Cheyenne Mountain, the dug-in Colorado mountain complex that houses NORAD, the joint US and Canadian air defence command. He gives no dates or details. If true, it would mean the military keeps secret facilities far below ground, the kind of place people imagine hidden work on unexplained things might happen.
